title: Kitso Handshake v0.1 — Disclosure artifact
description: A structured response from a Seeker Agent to a Vacancy Agent indicating the Seeker's principal's response to an Invitation. Carried as the Artifact of an A2A Task of type VacancyDisclosure.

disclosure_id.description: Unique identifier for this disclosure, scoped to the issuing Seeker Agent.

in_response_to.description: The invitation_id this disclosure responds to.

principal_confirmation.description: Evidence that the principal explicitly confirmed this decision. Required because §5 forbids agents from binding on behalf of the principal without explicit confirmation.

newly_disclosed.description: Additional Seeker information consented-to by the principal in response to this specific invitation. Each top-level key is the field domain (constraints, language_proficiency, etc.) and the value is the disclosed payload.

next_step_requested.description: What the Seeker side asks the Vacancy side to do next (e.g., 'vacancy_agent_disclose_company_and_comp').

alternative_terms_proposed.description: Used when principal_decision is propose_alternative_terms. Free-form payload describing the counter-proposal.
